# claude-mem-lite

> Persistent long-term memory for Claude Code (Anthropic's CLI coding agent) via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Captures coding decisions, bugfixes, and context across sessions; recalls them via hybrid FTS5 + TF-IDF search. Single local SQLite database, no external services. A lighter, lower-cost alternative to claude-mem — episode batching plus a smaller model reduce LLM cost substantially (an internal architecture estimate, not a measured benchmark).

claude-mem-lite is a Claude Code plugin (also installable via npm/npx) that runs as an MCP server plus a set of Claude Code lifecycle hooks (`SessionStart`, `PreCompact`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `Stop`, `UserPromptSubmit`). It automatically captures coding observations during sessions — file edits, bug fixes, decisions, refactors — then surfaces relevant past observations when you edit a related file or hit a familiar error. Search is hybrid: FTS5 BM25 + TF-IDF cosine similarity merged via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), with 100+ synonym pairs including CJK↔EN cross-language mappings. Benchmarked at 0.90 Recall@10 / 0.85 Precision@10 / 0.97 nDCG@10 / 0.96 MRR@10 across 200 observations / 30 queries, on the production-hybrid path (`benchmark/baseline.json`, sampled 2026-09-06). The previously published 0.96 Precision@10 came from the RETIRED FTS-only lexical path — a different caliber, not a better score: the hybrid arm trades raw precision@10 for recall, nDCG and MRR by surfacing semantically related candidates beyond exact lexical matches.

## Key concepts

- **MCP server**: registers 18 tools total; 9 core exposed to Claude Code (`mem_search`, `mem_recent`, `mem_recall`, `mem_timeline`, `mem_get`, `mem_save`, `mem_defer`, `mem_defer_list`, `mem_defer_drop`); 9 admin/maintenance tools hidden from `tools/list` but reachable via the `claude-mem-lite` CLI
- **Hooks** (seven events, as registered in `hooks/hooks.json`): `SessionStart` (context injection + handoff resume), `PreCompact` (pre-compaction snapshot), `PreToolUse` (file lesson recall before Edit/Write/Read; context for spawned agents), `PostToolUse` (episode capture), `PostToolUseFailure` (error-triggered recall on a host-flagged failure), `Stop` (episode flush + handoff snapshot), `UserPromptSubmit` (semantic memory injection)
- **Episode batching**: groups related tool calls (5–10 ops) before sending to LLM (Haiku) for structured observation extraction, instead of one LLM call per tool use (claude-mem original's model). Combined with the smaller model this is the source of the cost reduction — the headline multiplier is an architecture estimate (call-count × token × model-price reduction), not a measured end-to-end benchmark.
- **Hybrid retrieval**: FTS5 BM25 keyword search + TF-IDF cosine (512-dim vectors) semantic search, fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Synonym expansion handles abbreviations (`K8s`, `DB`, `auth`) and CJK↔EN cross-language (数据库↔database)
- **Cross-session handoff**: captures session state on `/clear` or `/exit`, re-injects on next session via FTS5 term overlap or `git SHA` continuation anchor
- **Invited memory pattern (v3.13+)**: installs a plugin-owned managed block into the project's `CLAUDE.md`, plus an on-demand detail doc at `.claude/plugin_claude_mem_lite.md`, so Claude Code loads the tool-use contract as project-instruction authority. NOT `MEMORY.md`: Claude Code loads both at equal weight, and seeding MEMORY.md would pollute an index meant for the user's own memories (`claudemd.mjs`). Auto-fires on first SessionStart per project; per-project (`adopt --disable`) and global (`MEM_NO_AUTO_ADOPT=1`) opt-outs available.

## Installation

- `/plugin marketplace add sdsrss/claude-mem-lite && /plugin install claude-mem-lite` (Claude Code plugin marketplace, recommended)
- `npx github:sdsrss/claude-mem-lite` (one-liner; installs to `~/.claude-mem-lite/`)
- `git clone https://github.com/sdsrss/claude-mem-lite.git && node install.mjs install` (for development)

Requires Node.js ≥ 22 (`package.json` `engines`; better-sqlite3 13 requires it and Node 20 reached EOL in 2026-04), Claude Code CLI. Linux/macOS only (uses POSIX shell scripts; `package.json` declares `os`).

## Related projects

- [claude-mem](https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem) — the original; claude-mem-lite is its ground-up redesign
- [mem0](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0) — general-purpose LLM memory framework (any LLM app, manual SDK)
- [modelcontextprotocol/servers](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/memory) — MCP reference `memory` server (knowledge-graph data model, manual tool calls)
- [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) — the parent product (Anthropic's CLI coding agent)
- [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) — the protocol claude-mem-lite implements
